## Required

One field: trip ID. Nine configuration, section, material, dimension and storage fields are optional.

A row with none of those nine fields produces a warning.

## Available

All 461 sets selected in 2025 have a branchline composition with length, MON leader material and 100% proportion.

Lengths range from 1.5 to 17.1 m; separate leader length is populated on 147 compositions.

For 209,430 individual branchlines, branchline/leader lengths and leader material are unpopulated.

These records do not yet establish ROS section-level coverage.

## To decide

Review component meaning and granularity with Pascal before mapping sections, materials or dimensions.

Confirm configuration identifiers and links from set-level sheets, storage coverage and final delivery levels.

**Agreed scope:** export the trip ID and branchline configuration ID only; leave section details empty.

Philippe selects the source composition ID. Export one row per distinct trip/configuration pair.

These two fields satisfy the form's declared rules, including its minimum-information warning condition.

Import must resolve the gear parent and map source identifiers to ROS integer identifiers or configuration numbers.

Confirm section-detail availability with IRD; no completed import has yet been demonstrated.

The database permits no configuration rows; reported configurations require a gear parent. IOTC rules remain open.
